description:
Goal

A demanded callable TransportShape(position) monotonically refines exact carried producer/use relations into one physical representation. ABI, backend, interpreter, and native consumers use that answer directly; no layer reselects producer identity from types, joined demand surfaces, ShapeIds, ordering, or session inventories.

North-star contract

- There is no transport seal, completion pass, whole-world census, or no-change completion signal.
- One requested product produces from exact current fact/product reads or returns exact waits.
- Completion is relative to the exact OutgoingEdgeFrontier generation already requested by the product DAG; later demand moves that generation.
- Dependency states/generations are memo metadata, never ProductValue data.
- Only an actual product back-edge may require local cyclic settlement. A recursive dependency cone is not automatically an SCC.
- Refinement preserves upstream identity and relations; it never reconstructs them from a physical summary.

Proven current positive case

The exact reproducer is the five-line program with two Enum.drop_while calls over one list. The broad 00420 fixture merges more callsites into 1/4/5/7-source sets and is not the paired final aggregate.

After root demand and every already-requested OutgoingInputEdges publisher settle, the current frontier exposes:

- target InputSlot: reduce_while_cont/3 activation Ty(87), semantic input 2;
- source A: reduce_while/3 activation Ty(81), ValueId(2), CallArgument;
- source B: reduce_while/3 activation Ty(219), ValueId(2), CallArgument.

The two source values are distinct semantic relations. Their independently requested child shapes are ShapeId(26)/CallableId(2)/ValueRef and ShapeId(29)/CallableId(3)/ValueRef. The target is the generic ShapeId(39)/CallableId(4)/ValueRef. Semantic identity lives in each carried (ExecutableKey, ValueId, role) and later callable flow/construction; identity-bearing ShapeId/CallableId differs; the common physical ABI is boxed ValueRef. Shape equality is therefore not the physical carrier boundary.

The current target TransportShape has no durable product dependencies beyond its monolithic TransportComponent. Neither child shape is requested; both exist only as closure side effects. The slot itself depends exactly on IncomingInputRelations(root) generation 1.

The legacy target solve touches 26 executables, 212 equality components, 416 positions, 209 anchors, and 204 equalities. The requested target component has one position, one anchor, and zero equalities. It is not an SCC. Before explicit child probes the drive settled 254 products and 35 component products; requesting two child shapes and their two relay slots added four named products and two more legacy component materializations.

Established foundation

fz-k22.5.1 provides immutable revisioned products, durable exact fact/product dependencies, final FactMovement states, atomic requested-publisher frontier generations, replaceable OutgoingInputEdges(E) contributions, IncomingInputRelations(root), exact IncomingInputSlot(slot) projections, and targeted closure retraction. This ticket consumes those authorities; it does not rebuild or compensate for them.

Proven local recipe and semantic construction graph

TransportShape(target Input)
  -> IncomingInputSlot(target, 2)
  -> TransportShape(Value(source A executable, 2))
  -> TransportShape(Value(source B executable, 2))

Both branches then follow only exact local aliases and one-source slots:

A: reduce_while F172/Ty81 V2 -> reduce F168/Ty69 V2 -> F70/Ty69 V2 -> F66/Ty41 V5 -> Lambda F160(captures=[V1])
B: reduce_while F172/Ty219 V2 -> reduce F168/Ty217 V2 -> F70/Ty217 V2 -> F66/Ty214 V5 -> Lambda F160(captures=[V1])

Every nonterminal local recipe is Value(2) == ExecutableInput[2]; each executable crossing is one exact IncomingInputSlot CallArgument relation. No position repeats through either terminal semantic construction, so this graph has no product back-edge or non-singleton SCC. The legacy CycleFrame remains internal projector recursion, not evidence of a product SCC.

A test-only immutable LocalTransportRecipes(E) value is proven local. It contains directed position equalities, named Ty/RuntimeDemand anchors, input-slot references, local FunctionRef/Lambda descriptors with the matching CallableFlowFact, and selected local CallSiteSummary mappings. Its builder accepts only LoweredBody, ActivationAnalyzed, ReturnType, local CallSiteSummary values, and RuntimeDemand(E); it has no session or neighboring-context input and carries no ShapeId. Equal named inputs produce equal recipes; moving ActivationAnalyzed value types changes the recipe.

LoweredBody plus RuntimeDemand.callable_flows[V5] already preserve semantic construction authority: function/captures, direct and first-class surfaces/edges, exact resolution keys, semantic-input mappings, and opaque/escape state. A separate producer-position CallableConstruction product is required to own and address physical projection, not to rediscover semantic identity. Its physical graph is now fully traced: 50 TransportShape nodes and 154 directed candidate edges, including 2 capture children, 14 resolution-input children, 6 return children, and 27 shared dependencies. Kahn residual is empty; every SCC is a singleton. No grouped settlement is justified for this paired case.

CallableDemand is proven sufficient as the direct/public use authority: resolved/targets with !is_first_class is grounded direct use; opaque or escape is public use. A pure candidate over exact source identities plus child layouts yields absent for an exact empty set, waits on a missing child, preserves the exact child layout only for one direct-only source, and otherwise retains every identity with the public ValueRef carrier. Distinct identities with equal layouts cannot cross-select.

Fresh forward and reverse service of the same publisher set produce identical normalized slot relations, target/child values and layouts, generations, LocalTransportRecipes, and 154 candidate edges. The paired graph reaches 103 exact candidate keys versus 416 legacy positions; this is a graph-size measurement, not yet a runtime claim.

Proven recursive product groups

Minimal self recursion produces one exact self-looping shape key X with equation X = join(A, X), where A is the external concrete lambda child. Minimal mutual recursion produces exactly two reciprocal shape keys with X = join(A, Y) and Y = join(X). Representative maplist recursion repeats the self equation. The SCCs are respectively {X}, {X,Y}, and {X}; LocalTransportRecipes, IncomingInputSlot, CallableConstruction, input, and anchor keys remain outside.

These groups are pass-through aliases plus named external children. They prove that the acyclic paired graph does not generalize to all programs, while also disproving the 26-executable closure as the settlement unit. Existing sequential ProductReadContext::publish_product is not proof of atomic grouped memo publication.

Required refinement

- Zero carried relations is exact absence according to the current slot generation; it is not permission to invent a semantic fallback.
- One relation may use a direct representation only when CallableDemand proves grounded direct-only use. Otherwise it uses the public carrier.
- Multiple producer identities retain every alternative and use their common public boxed callable ABI. Physical equality never chooses semantic identity.
- Local source facts must extend the proven callable/equality prefix to the complete local TransportSource vocabulary: returns, inputs, local aliases, callsite returns, joins, tuples, tuple fields, callable producers, resume/delivery mappings, and named anchors. They do not project ShapeIds or read neighboring contexts.
- CallableConstruction(producer position) refines the preserved semantic descriptor through exact capture/input/return/boundary shape children. CallableFacts and BoundaryFacts derive from named construction/publication products or wait.
- An actual recursive position SCC settles only its exact reentered keys from named external dependencies and publishes immutable member answers atomically. No mid-ascent value is observable.

Remaining proof gates before implementation

1. Prototype atomic grouped ProductMemo publication for the exact {X} and {X,Y} groups: install every member and dependency before invalidating external readers; exclude internal cycle edges from retained dependencies or prove an equivalent exact representation; advance only changed member generations.
2. Falsify SCC settlement with no anchor, one anchor, equal multiple anchors, conflicting anchors, source replacement, external-anchor withdrawal, equal reproduction, and forward/reverse traversal. Prove the finite callable physical lattice/equations; stop if a richer lattice is required.
3. Prove the complete LocalTransportRecipes vocabulary is local and sufficient for representative non-callable tuple/join/callsite-return/resume paths before deleting the whole closure solver. The current prototype proves only the callable/equality prefix.
4. Only after all gates pass, implement test-first and delete the legacy whole-closure solve, snapshot facades, selector/fallback, manufactured demand, custom freshness ledgers, temporary probes, and obsolete cache/resource tests in one atomic commit.

Rejected boundaries

- filtering producer identities through joined demand, rendered Ty, ShapeId, CallableId, debug order, or physical equality;
- generic fallback as semantic evidence;
- recovering identity downstream after boxing;
- treating a dependency cone as an SCC;
- sequential per-key publication presented as atomic group settlement;
- a parallel stamped cache/facade;
- historical ExecutableTransportFacts, which performed context-sensitive projection.

Signal

- The paired input pulls both producer-value children and no unrelated component.
- Both valid producers survive into one public callable ABI; same-layout distinct identities cannot cross-select.
- Exact requests, reads, waits, generations, replacement, withdrawal, and child products are observable through production telemetry/tests.
- Recursive settlement groups exactly the concrete reentered shape keys and publishes no provisional values.
- Forward and reverse schedules produce equal product values and generations without debug/render sorting.
- Whole-closure projection, snapshot inventories, selector/fallback logic, manufactured demand, and custom closure freshness state are deleted, not bypassed.
- Lower layers consume final transport answers and named construction/fact products without reconstruction.
- Full library tests, targeted behavior fixtures, strict all-target clippy, formatting, and before/after product/work measurements pass.

Scope

No production implementation begins until every remaining proof gate above is resolved. fz-k22.30 remains blocked here. fz-k22.31 owns the uncalled first-class discrepancy. fz-k22.29 may consume the eventual authority only after it exists.
title: Make callable transport determination a product-owned refinement
